nodes.name: date.js
nodes.summary: ControlDate form control extending ControlData. Wraps flatpickr for date input with locale-aware parsing, formatting, min/max validation, and week-start configuration.

nodes.name: ControlDate
nodes.summary: Date picker control extending ControlData. Builds flatpickr instance, parses and validates date strings, enforces min/max dates, updates on keyboard input and picker change.

nodes.name: date_range.js
nodes.summary: ControlDateRange form control extending ControlData. Uses flatpickr in range mode to select two dates and persist them as JSON array value.

nodes.name: ControlDateRange
nodes.summary: Date range picker control. Overrides make_input to attach flatpickr with mode:'range', formats/parses ranges to/from JSON array strings.

nodes.name: datepicker_i18n.js
nodes.summary: Localization data for flatpickr: weekday/month names, ordinals, and first-day-of-week for 40+ languages. Pure data module attached to frappe.datepicker_i18n.

nodes.name: datetime.js
nodes.summary: ControlDatetime form control extending ControlDate. Enables time picker in flatpickr, handles timezone conversion between user and system timezone, and formats sys_datetime values.

nodes.name: ControlDatetime
nodes.summary: Datetime picker control. Adds time picker to ControlDate, converts between system and user timezones, and handles datetime formatting including 'Now' shortcut.

nodes.name: duration.js
nodes.summary: ControlDuration form control extending ControlData. Provides a dialog with day/hour/minute/second inputs for entering duration as total seconds, honoring hide_days and hide_seconds options.

nodes.name: ControlDuration
nodes.summary: Duration control storing value as integer seconds. Opens picker dialog with day/hour/minute/second inputs, formats human-readable output via frappe.utils.get_formatted_duration, parses string input back to seconds.

nodes.name: dynamic_link.js
nodes.summary: ControlDynamicLink form control extending ControlLink. Resolves target DocType dynamically from another field on the document (options points to fieldname).

nodes.name: float.js
nodes.summary: ControlFloat form control extending ControlInt. Parses and formats float values with precision, applying currency-style decimal handling.

nodes.name: geolocation.js
nodes.summary: ControlGeolocation form control extending ControlData. Embeds a Leaflet map with draw controls for points/polygons, persisting GeoJSON as value. Handles locate-me, bounds, edit/read-only modes.

nodes.name: ControlGeolocation
nodes.summary: Geolocation control. Lazily loads Leaflet and leaflet-draw assets, builds an interactive map with drawing tools, serializes features to GeoJSON FeatureCollection, and renders read-only preview on non-editable forms.

nodes.name: heading.js
nodes.summary: ControlHeading form control extending ControlHTML. Trivial subclass used for heading section labels in forms.

nodes.name: html.js
nodes.summary: ControlHTML form control extending base Control. Renders arbitrary HTML content (from df.options or set_value) into the form area, supports get/set of raw HTML.
